scope: Theorem 13.1 (Strictness for two spherical components) of the manuscript “Equality and rigidity in the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Equality-and-rigidity-in-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f1aab59ba484eb8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 110. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (M, g, K) be smooth connected orientable three-dimensional initial data without boundary, with g complete and with finitely many asymptotically flat ends outside a compact set. Assume on every end g − δ = O2(r−q ), K = O1(r−1−q ), q > 1 2, integrable constraint densities µ, |J|g, finite ADM charges, and µ ≥ |J|g everywhere. Here 16πµ = Rg + (trg K)2 − |K|2 g and 8πJ = divg(K − (trg K)g). Let S1, S2 be disjoint smooth embedded two-sided spheres, and suppose that the closure Ω of the connected exterior toward a designated end has boundary S = S1 ⊔ S2 and exactly that one end. Orient S into Ω. Assume θ+ = H + trS K = 0 on S, and assume every full enclosing cut has area at least A = |S1|g + |S2|g. A full cut is the entire compact smooth frontier of a connected end-containing outer domain, with all components and coincident portions of S counted and bounded complementary pockets filled. Finally assume there is no such cut Γ ̸= S whose components either equal an Si or lie wholly in the open exterior, with at least one component in the open exterior and θ+(Γ) ≤ 0 toward the designated end. If that end has E > |P|δ, then √︂ E2 − |P|2 δ > √︄ |S1|g + |S2|g 16π .
